verbatim_sources: Build more when more creates value
Preserve diversity when diversity creates insight
DO NOT REDUCE THE VISION TO MAKE THE WORK EASIER
MASTER IT. DO NOT MUTILATE IT.

If one evidence path fails, search another
TURN EVERY MATERIAL EVENT INTO A PROPOSITION THAT CAN BE PROVEN, ATTACKED, STRENGTHENED, AND USED

verified_provider_state: GitHub readback resolved GlacierEQ/Genius-Mastery commit a6e111e349ae2c900bb95ae5c2bafc1cce2f3a16 as fix(bridge): pin operating loop to source-faithful head.
GitHub readback resolved GlacierEQ/Genius-Mastery commit eb63c06b46812ccc43f80a37b480ff2638d5e0b5 as feat: enforce source-faithful long-run progress.
Clean mega-skills main clone validated run-07 before mutation.
Operator Mac was online and ~/bin/skills exposed status/activate/deactivate/reset/search/recommend.
source_classification.inference: A typed identifier without an independently bound proof record is only classification, not provider proof. A host capability marked unverified after the host is reachable is stale continuity state and should be actively re-probed.
source_classification.contradiction: Run-07 LATEST recorded the Operator host as offline/unverified, while direct device readback in this run showed KcBs-MacBook-Air.local online and the Skills CLI executable available.
source_classification.prior_assistant_interpretation: Prior passes correctly kept host proof separate from repository CI, but the host lane was never closed because the device had been offline.

failure_pattern_attacked: Provider-state v2 typed external commits and blobs but did not prove typed exceptions inside CI; the durable continuity pointer also retained a stale host-unverified state after the Operator device became reachable.
concrete_outputs: direct Operator-host Skills lifecycle receipt with exact state restoration
verification: 6/6 opt-in Operator-host Skills tests passed against ~/bin/skills
counterevidence: The first v3 test run failed because v2 fixtures were not migrated; the validator was retained and fixtures were upgraded to the new proof-bearing contract before rerun.
The normal Operator mega-skills checkout was behind provider main and contained unrelated modifications; it was deliberately not mutated. A clean provider-synced clone was used.

objective_state_delta.before: Cross-repository commit/blob state was typed but not proof-bound in the validator, and the Operator host Skills lifecycle remained explicitly unverified.
objective_state_delta.after: Provider-state v3 now requires a digest-bound provider readback manifest for external objects, verifies same-repository blobs by Git object type, rejects tampered/missing proofs, and the real Operator-host Skills lifecycle is directly verified with exact post-run state restoration.

unresolved: Provider-readback manifest creation is still manually produced from connected GitHub readback rather than refreshed by an automated provider-native collector.
Cross-repository proof freshness is immutable-object strong but does not yet record a revalidation/observation timestamp policy.
next_executable_frontier: Automate provider-readback manifest refresh from provider-native GitHub evidence, bind each cross-repository proof to fetch metadata plus immutable object identity, add stale-proof expiry/revalidation semantics without weakening offline deterministic CI, and propagate the now-verified host-runtime lane into the recovery contract so future runs distinguish provider proof freshness from host proof freshness.
